content: Yesu hilin Saul alopayo
+ o 9:1 Sin 8:3*Saul nêêl niwêêk lôôt nambe biing nindanjeen vu Omaaho Bop-ate hil de nyiis sil-ambe lanjimb, om la vu kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv bop,
be nêêl vu nambe kaavu kaapiya na nohvu hil Yuda-te dumb ti ti vu Damaskas naambe, “Saul naatovu moow ayuuh vêêh sen lawii-having Yesu-te tanasin-ato, ond talu sil-ambe gako na Yelusalem.”
Om Saul monala be la valup ngaaho vu Damaskas, tombe sim pavis atombe kin ti tum vu baandoni be têêlang ak yi,
tombe Saul lupake be la neep voon, tonde hango lava ti laam vu yi nambe, “Saul, nambe vaati sen goo monawiing nindanjeen vu saa-jo?”
+ o 9:5 Sin 5:39; 1Ko 15:8*Tombe Saul lingin nambe, “Omaaho Bop, olati?” Le nêêl nambe, “Sa Yesu sen goo monawiing nindanjeen vu saa-jo.
Om okandi be gana bayêên e mem le daanêêl va sen gambiing-ato langaah vu hong.”
Hil sen laving Saul-ato, ond lango lavaa-ju lemu me-layi omaaho ti le, om lavand ma de yoo daale.
Tombe Saul kandi naale le ma de mekanu hôôk lôôt, om sil laliv namand hôôk-ambe lala Damaskas,
tombe nandôô-ju lohvu busin yaal osin mekanu, de me-ya vanôôn ayuuh me-num bel e.
Tonde Yesu-te omaaho ti nando Damaskas haale nambe Ananaias, ond nando le yi taahu taahu ti, de Omaaho Bop nêêl vu nambe, “Ananaias.” Tombe liinggis nambe, “Omaaho Bop, saa-jo.”

+ o 9:11 Sin 21:39*Tombe Omaaho Bop nêêl vu nambe, “Okandi jak-ambe gana mopaatôôv sen danêêl nambe Nivalok-ato, tombe onaatovu hil Taasas ti haale nambe Saul, ond monalohak nando hôôk Yudas-ate bayêên,
de yi taahu taahu ti de omaaho ti haale nambe Ananaias lukalaam umakalo be hambe nama lak yi in nambe me naatum naah.”
+ o 9:13 Sin 8:3*Le Ananaias nêêl nambe, “Omaaho Bop, sa hango de hil ngeeyaata danêêl nambe omaahôô-ju nawiing nindanjeen lôôt vu gate hil vu Yelusalem,
+ o 9:14 Sin 9:1-2,21; 1Ko 1:2*tonde yêêv-aso salivangin-ate lanêêl lung la nambe yoo talu hil pin sen lavand nahôôk ohaalem vuu-jôôto.”

+ o 9:15 Sin 25:13,23; 27:24; Lom 1:5*Lemu Omaaho Bop nêêl vu nambe, “Gana. Saaholin yi be tu sate hil kul vaha lung la in gako sa haalengg na vu omaahonôôn pin, de vu lulemak-aso osin hil Islel gaving.
+ o 9:16 2Ko 11:23-28*De nimeen pin sen naatovu yi jak sa haalengg-ato ond soo le naanêêl taato vu yi.”

Om Ananaias kandi be la hato lukala bayêên alo, tombe hambe nama lak Saul de nêêl vu nambe, “Hali Saul-e, Omaaho Bop Yesu sen taato yi langaah vu hong vu mop lavuun-ato, ond nêêl-ambe sa laam in nambe gamem naatum naah, de Vavi Vaambuung e naam dôôvu hong.”
Om pavis atombe va sen nando hôôk Saul amêê-to lumbin nambe paahuung anikapis-ato, tonde Saul ame tum laah, tombe kandi lak-ambe lipis bel lak Yesu haale,
de ya vanôôn-ambe sake lukalaah. Saul nêêl banye nivasa langaah vu Damaskas Saul nando having Yesu-te hil vu Damaskas-anju busin heey,
ond pavis-ambe nêêl Yesu-te banye nivasa langaah hatup hôôk hil Yuda-te dumb ti ti nambe, “Yesuu-ju ond Anutu Noow yi.”

+ o 9:21 Sin 8:3; 26:10*Tombe hil vaalu sen lango yite vakasin-anjuuto sil pin lavindis lôôt, de lanêêl nambe, “Ayêê, omaahôô-ja nayiis hil sen lavand nahôôk Yesu haale vu Yelusalem-ato, ond laam in naanduuh hil vuu-jo de gako sil lana vu yêêv-aso salivangin-ate, le mak nambe vaatii-jo?”

+ o 9:22 Sin 17:3; 18:5,28*Lemu Saul-ate niwêêk tu bopaata lak, om nêêl taato vu sil nambe Yesuu-ju yi omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato keen, tombe hil Yuda sen dando Damaskas-ato lango yite vakasin-anju, tombe silanêênd vakasin sen daanêêl naah vuu-to ma.
Hil Yuda ahend kalin vu Saul om pak
+ o 9:23 Sin 23:12*Tombe busin ngeeyaata la lung la, le mem hil Yuda lasupin-ambe lanjôôy vakasin nambe lanyiis Saul-ambe jimb.
Saul hango silate vakasin-anju banye nambe hil Yuda dambuuh mop avi lohvu taaku pin hôôk busin-ande langaah in nambe lanyiis-ambe jimb,

+ o 9:25 2Ko 11:32-33*om Saul-ate hil sen dando having yii-to lako yi hôôk busin-ambe lalakala kaatum alu baandoni, tombe latung lukala nando hôôk jaambang bopaata ti, le mem sil taaluuhin yi la voon-ambe la.
Saul la nando Yelusalem
+ o 9:26 Gal 1:17-19*Saul la hato Yelusalem-ambe wiingin nambe na mando gaving Yesu-te hil, le sil pin layêênin Saul lôôt in me-lawii-having nambe Yesu-te omaaho yi le.

+ o 9:27 Sin 9:4,20; 1Ko 9:1; 15:8*Lemu Banabas giiy-ambe yuuh lala vu sinaale-so, de hatulin vakasin sen Saul yi Omaaho Bop vu mop lavuun-ambe Omaaho Bop vakaas vu yii-to, osin nêêl vakasin sen Saul nêêl Yesu haale langaah vu hil vu Damaskas-ande me-yêênin-ato le.
Saul nando having sil vu Yelusalem, ond yoo nêêl tanasin lak Omaaho Bop haale niwêêk lôôt de me-yêênin e.
Tonde having Yuda vaalu sen dakaas Glik lavand-ato, ond sil papenggin sil in tanasin, tombe sim hil-anju lawiingin nambe lanyiis Saul-ambe jimb.
+ o 9:30 Sin 11:25; Gal 1:21*Le sim Omaaho Bop-ate hil langoyin banye tombe langgiiy Saul-ambe lala Sisalia, le mem lawiing yi vuu-ju be la Taasas.

Tombe mem hil bel-ate vu Yudia yuuh Galili, de taaku Samaalia pin, dando nivasa de ngaamong ayuuh ame ma. Layêênin sil vu Omaaho Bop de Vavi Vaambuung vu niwêêk vu sil, tombe mem hil bel-ate latu ngeeyaata lak lôôt.
Pita wiing-ambe Inias anivasa lak
Pita monatup hôôk lohvu taaku pin-ambe la hato vu Omaaho Bop-ate hil sen dando Lidaa-to,
tombe sim tovu omaaho ti haale nambe Inias vuu-ju, ond kook tasiis-ande yoo neep hôôk bayêên alo lohvu ta namaavaalu be vindak yaal lung la.
Tombe Pita nêêl vu nambe, “Inias, gêên Yesu Kalisi wiing-ambe ganim vasa lak, om okandi jak-ambe goo gatongin gate kaanye.” Tombe kandi lak pavi-vasa.
Tombe hil Lida osin hil vu Salon pin layi be lahilin londpayo la vu Omaaho Bop.
Pita wiing-ambe Tabita kandi lak laah
Vêêh ti wii-having Yesu nando Jopa haale nambe Tabita, Glik lavand nambe Dokas, ond lak busin pin yoo navu samu hil, de nahôôvu hil sen dativak in va yuuh amêê-to.
Tombe sim busin ti tombe nilak-ambe yimb, om lalipis ninaavi de lambe lakala neep ak bayêên alo ango baandonii-to.
Tonde Yesu-te hil langoyin nambe Pita nando Lida sen neep ngaaho vu taaku Jopaa-to, om lawiing omaaho yuuh lala vu be yuuh kataangg yi nambe, “Ganaam pavis vu hey e.”

Om Pita kandi lak-ambe la having yuuh. La hato tombe lako yi be lalakala bayêên alo baandoni, tombe vehaahôôv-aso pin lako lolop ayuuh ame sen Dokas nando having sil bôôy-ambe duuh-ato, ond sil taato vu Pita de lasu lak yi.

+ o 9:40 Mak 5:40-41*Tombe Pita hatiiy hil pin lala voon, de hatung kaatu be lohak, tonde hilin laah vu omaahonôôn yimbin-ato be nêêl nambe, “Tabita, okandi.” Tombe vêêh-anjuuto me tum-ambe yi Pita de kandi nando,
tombe Pita laandiiy hôôk nama be kandi naale, de teey vehaahôôv-aso osin Omaaho Bop-ate hil pin lalaam-ambe taato vu sil nambe Dokas ame tum laah.
Tombe hil Jopa pin lango vakasin-anjôôto banye, om hil ngeeyaata lawii-having Omaaho Bop.
+ o 9:43 Sin 10:6*Tonde Pita nando Jopa busin ngeeyaata having omaaho ti haale nambe Simon sen nawiing kul bik naavii-to.
